paper_metadata.title: On the origin of a remarkable increase in strength and stability of an Al rich Al-Ni eutectic alloy by Zr addition

The synergistic effect of Al 3Zr strengthened α-Al phase and coarsening resistant Al-Al 3Ni eutectic due to interfacial Zr segregation leads to an excellent high-temperature strength of 218 MPa at 250 oC for ternary Al-3.1Ni-0.15Zr alloy.
This might be due to an enhanced resistance of eutectic microstructure against coarsening due to Zr addition in the alloy.
